name: Road to Emerald
original_name: ロード・トゥ・エメラルド
source:
Going home the same way she always had, Dorthy decides to enter a peculiar bookshop on a whim and opens a book; The Wizard of Oz.

She finds herself in a magic kingdom and befriends
Otto, the scarecrow
Gragg, the Tin Man
and Friday, the Lion.

They all go on a journey to find Oz, a wish-granting wizard in Emerald City.

Will she be able to return to her world?
Despite clashes with an evil wizard,
the romantic adventure unfolds.

[Edited from [url=http://www.imagecircus.co.jp/renai/i-phone/en_01road.php]Official site[/url]]
